subject: Application for Junior Backend API Developer - John Doe
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Junior Backend API Developer position at Example Software Studio. With five years of experience at Acme Corp building scalable APIs using Python, Django, and FastAPI, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your backend team.

I have extensive experience writing SQL queries, managing data flows, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver robust software solutions. My background aligns perfectly with your requirements for maintaining and documenting RESTful services.

Attached is my CV for your review. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my technical skills can support Example Software Studio.

Best regards,
John Doe
+90 555 555 55 55
